environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with execution role 'ServiceAuthLambdaRole-Prod' in account 444555666777. The KMS key (alias/service-auth-key) is backed by an AWS CloudHSM cluster (CUSTOM_KEY_STORE origin) with key material generated and held exclusively within the HSM partition. The Lambda role's IAM policy grants kms:Sign with a StringEquals condition restricting SigningAlgorithm to 'RSASSA_PKCS1_V1_5_SHA_256' only. An SCP (id: scp-0a8b3c4d5e) attached at the OU level denies kms:PutKeyPolicy and kms:CreateGrant for all principals except the account's CloudFormation service role (condition: aws:PrincipalArn != arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/CloudFormationDeployRole). The Lambda's IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::444555666777:policy/LambdaHSMBoundary) explicitly denies kms:PutKeyPolicy, kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, kms:ImportKeyMaterial, and kms:CreateGrant. The custom key store's CloudHSM cluster requires quorum authentication (m-of-n with m=3, n=5) for key policy modifications at the HSM firmware level, independent of AWS IAM.
